title: Stress and the written accent

summary_es.en: Where the stress falls can change the word: papa and papá are different.
summary_es.fr: La place de l’accent peut changer le mot : papa et papá sont différents.
summary_es.zh: 重音位置会改变词义：papa 与 papá 不同。
summary_es.ja: アクセントの位置で語が変わります：papa と papá は別の語です。

tip_es: In Spanish, words ending in a vowel, “n” or “s” are stressed on the next-to-last syllable; the rest are stressed on the last one. A written accent marks the exceptions. Stress can change the meaning, so say the stressed syllable louder and longer.

confusions.tip_es: It heard “papa” (potato). The stress goes on the last syllable: pa-PÁ.
It heard “papá”. Here the stress goes on the first syllable: PA-pa.
